BrochureContent.Content:
-Spectacular Panoramic Southerly Views Of Dublin Bay & City To Wicklow Head

-5-Bedroom, 5-Bathroom Detached Family Home On Arguably One Of Dublin's Finest Homesites

-Includes Brand New One Bedroom Self Contained Apartment Finished To The Highest Of Specification

-Private Home Spa With Large Indoor Swimming Pool, Steam Room & Oversized Jacuzzi Hot-Tub

-All Weather Floodlit Tennis Court

-Magnificent 6-Star Resort Standard Landscaped Grounds  

-To View A Special Video Presentation, Copy & Paste This Link:  https://youtu.be/FfkdLGYs6tk


Premium Collection are proud to present this truly magnificent 5 bedroom detached family home situated on arguably one of Dublin's most spectacular homesites on the south side of Howth Hill in Co. Dublin. Offering panoramic views over Dublin Bay, looking south over the sea and coast as far as Wicklow Head, this home sits on 3 levels and is surrounded by wonderful 6-star resort standard landscaped gardens that provide stunning views over the bay and city skyline. Incorporated within this fantastic home is a 1300 sqft brand new (with FPP) self contained one bedroomed apartment finished to the highest of standards and specification and is perfect for a relative, staff and/or guests. In addition, there is a fully equipped private Spa area with a spectacular large indoor mosaic tile finished swimming pool, steam sauna and oversized jacuzzi hot-tub and to the rear includes an elevated full size all weather floodlit tennis court.

The wonderful design of this light and bright home ensures that spectacular views are maximised in every room. Comprising both formal and casual living spaces the clever layout provides excellent separation blending both entertainment and serenity under one roof. Upstairs, all of the bedrooms are very spacious and are accessed from a central landing, finished to the highest quality, and comprise extensive wardrobe space. The large master bedroom includes an abundance of top quality fitted wardrobes and a large ensuite bathroom together with wonderful sea views and includes beautiful feature stained glass window. There is also a very spacious and elegantly finished main bathroom which comprises a separate bath and shower. An open balcony runs along the entirety of the upper level which also includes a wonderfully spacious living room offering magnificent bay and city views through floor to ceiling sliding glass and also includes a stunning marble feature fireplace. 


The beautifully landscaped grounds outside comprise a wide range of exotic flowerbeds, trees, walkways, lawns, patios and numerous water features. At night, the exceptional lighting ensures that the gardens are in full splendour day or night and the elevated position of this home ensures that everywhere one stops on the property, whether inside or out, the magnificent panoramic views are on display. 

The first impression one gets upon entering the spacious main hallway is one of sumptuous quality. To the left is a craft room and home office and to the right are the main living spaces with both formal and casual living rooms. This level also features a superbly appointed gourmet kitchen, including state-of-the-art appliances, a wonderful array of country French kitchen cabinetry and generous preparation space with a large Kitchen island and granite countertops. Perfectly suited to the discerning home chef, this space is ideal for both entertaining and culinary creativity and the floor to ceiling glass patio doors provide magnificent views of Dublin Bay as a backdrop.

Accessed through custom designed double wrought iron gates, the main formal living/dining room is a special feature in itself as it incorporates a beautifully crafted wood-paneled bar, a magnificent stone feature fireplace and a wonderful stained glass ceiling at the centre. Large floor to ceiling silding glass doors invite you outside to a raised patio deck which provides expansive panoramic views of the Dublin bay and city and the Wicklow coastline.

The self contained apartment is exceptional. Situated on the ground floor, brand new, never lived in and ultra modern, it comes with it's own seperate entrance. Comprising over 1300 sqft of living space, accommodation includes a fully fitted SeiMatic kitchen with utility room, study, main living room, spacious bedroom with walk-in wardrobe and ensuite bathroom. All main rooms are light and bright with excellent views and open out to the front south facing gardens. It is totally self contained with an Air-to-Water heat pump with underfloor heating and finished to the highest of standards.

The beautifully landscaped grounds outside are 6-star resort standard. Comprising a wide range of exotic flowerbeds, trees, sleeper step walkways, lawns, patios and numerous water features, the exceptional lighting ensures that the gardens are in full splendour day or night and the elevated position of this home ensures that everywhere one stops on the property, whether inside or out, the magnificent panoramic views are on display. 

The systems contained within this property are state-of-the-art with the Plant Room being totally refitted in 2024. Practically everything in the home is operated from a smart App system whether it be the lighting, security, intercom, cctv or the electric gates to the front. 

The large sweeping driveway can accommodate plenty of vehicles and the numerous water features and fountains throughout create an instant relaxing ambiance as soon as you enter the property.

To top it off, this home also includes an incredible entertaining space at the top level with a large deck patio with all-weather thatched roof pergola plus a fully fitted garden kitchen and smart music system. The views are some of the best that Dublin can offer from this level and this is an ideal space for both large and more intimate get togethers. 

To say that this property needs to be seen to be truly appreciated is an understatement. 

Howth Village has an abundance of amenities including the historic harbour with its fish shops and excellent restaurants and pubs, Howth Yacht Club, cafes, boutiques, summer passenger ferries to Ireland's Eye and Dun Laoghaire, scenic Howth Cliff and hillside hikes, the Dart station and bus routes. There are excellent schools, golf clubs and various sports clubs and facilities nearby. Dublin City Centre is 25 mins drive away and the airport is a 20-minute drive.

Viewing is strictly by appointment and we very much look forward to showing it to you.

***All information provided is to the best of our knowledge. The utmost of care and attention has been placed on providing factual and correct information. In certain cases some information may have been provided by the vendor to us. We do not hold any responsibility for mistakes, errors or inaccuracies in our online advertising and give each and every viewer the right to get an opinion on any concern they may have***
